title: Platinum Games Announces New Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin Game
content: Paramount Games announced during the Summer Game Fest 2026 livestream on Friday that Platinum Games is developing a new game in the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles franchise titled Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin .
author: ANN

title: Bandai Namco Announces Gundam: Rogue Orbit Game
content: Bandai Namco announced during the Summer Game Fest 2026 livestream on Friday a new game in the Gundam franchise titled Gundam Rogue Orbit . The game is scheduled to launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC via Steam in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Resident Evil: Code Veronica Game Gets Remake
content: CAPCOM announced during the Summer Game Fest 2026 livestream on Friday Resident Evil Veronica , a remake, or reimagining, of the 2000 Resident Evil: Code Veronica game, for release on PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in 2027.
author: ANN

title: 5 Shonen Anime Heroes Ranked by Their Tragic Stories
content: Shonen anime protagonists usually follow a familiar mold, one built around heroic energy and the ability to inspire viewers. While this is the standard blueprint for many shonen heroes, there are also plenty who come from very different foundations.

title: Crunchyroll Hidden Gem Fantasy Confirms Sequel After 2 Years With First Teaser
content: Crunchyroll is planning to have a big summer, with next month’s Anime Expo slated to see the streaming service make a serious splash. The platform is planning to focus on series such as Gachiakuta, Demon Slayer, Daemons of the Shadow Realm, The Apothecary Diaries, Witch Hat Atelier , and many more.

title: Crunchyroll Manga Adds 24 Titles in Latest June 2026 Update
content: Crunchyroll is currently the largest streaming hub for anime fans across the globe. Launched in 2017, the streaming platform didn’t take long to rise through the ranks and eventually add a plethora of anime series and films that can’t be found elsewhere. This includes the seasonal anime lineup released each quarter.

title: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even Anime Reveals New Trailer, July 6 Premiere
content: A Livid Lady’s Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires anime revealed a new trailer featuring a July 6 premiere date. Two additional cast members have also been announced. The first half of Episode 1 will make its world premiere at REMOW’s industry panel at Anime Expo this July.
